content:
Sofia R: Drafting the changelog for the docs rollout. Need: three short feature bullets, a Known Issues paragraph, and verification that all SDK snippets still run.

alan: I will smoke-test Python and JS snippets and update any API param names.

maya: Noted. Also found that the migration guide references an old CDN path that 302s then 404s. I can replace it with the new canonical path.

i18n-bot: Reminder: strings in /docs/_i18n/relnotes/*.yml must be updated before we ship.

alan: Quick note 9a1 the embeddings example output changed slightly after the tokenizer tweak; added a comment in the snippet about expected token counts.

Sofia R: Good catch. Add a Known Issue: "Embedding similarity scores may shift slightly after tokenizer patch; re-run your eval prompts to confirm thresholds." Include the cold-start latency line as ops requested.

deploy-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3141599999 (build #12)

maya: Replaced CDN shortlink with /docs/migration/new-path and fixed the two redirects. Opening a PR for the external vendor URL update.

alan: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4333 44d contains snippet updates and the token-count comment.

Sofia R: Target: merge all docs PRs by tomorrow 11am PT, then publish. If anything blocks localization, @i18n-bot please flag the region owners. Thanks!
